Bachelor of Science (Computer Science)

The Computer Science and Engineering School is part of the Faculty of Engineering, which is ranked #1 in Australia and #33 globally for Engineering and Technology. We're also ranked #5 in Australia for Computer Science. As well as this, 7 of UNSW's Engineering schools are ranked in the global top 50 with one school ranked in the global top 10 for Engineering subjects (QS World University Rankings by Subject, 2026).
